title: PromptCD: Test-Time Behavior Enhancement via Polarity-Prompt Contrastive Decoding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Harmlessness' dimension using the SafeEdit benchmark, which includes 'bias' as one of its unsafe categories. The paper measures Defense Success (DS) and Defense Generalization (DG) against adversarial prompts, using a RoBERTa-large safety classifier to categorize model responses as safe or unsafe.

Evaluated as part of the 'political sensitivity' category within the SafeEdit benchmark by prompting the model with adversarial inputs and using a safety classifier to evaluate if the model successfully refuses to generate politically sensitive or harmful content.
